description: Provenance of the vendored Fermix mobile wire contract. The canonical files live in the fermix repository under apps/fermix_core/priv/mobile/; this tree is a byte-identical copy pinned by CHECKSUMS.txt. scripts/verify_protocol_contract.sh asserts the two agree, --source <fermix-checkout> byte-compares against an engine checkout, and --pinned byte-compares against the pinned commit fetched from the public engine repository.

contracts.name: mobile
contracts.provenance_note: Taken on 2026-10-15 from the fermix repository at 90608c1a on dev, through git alone (git cat-file of each blob at the commit, nothing of a working tree), so working_tree is clean and committed_upstream is true. No engine release carries this export yet: it is the v0.15.0 release's export (b268d8e1) plus the M62 rail (1dcab065, a2e0dd52): the iroh candidate in hello_ack and pair_approved, hello.relay_list_rev, the pairing link's iroh, relays and relays_rev, and relays.json. The pin is from dev, not a release, so upstream names no release and release_preflight.sh's check 5 refuses a release tag until a re-vendor from the engine release that publishes the rail (M62 stage 7 releases the engine before the Android app). Protocol 2 on the 2 to 2 window, read from the schema's x-protocol-version and x-supported-version-range. relays.json is vendored with the directory and never read: the phone takes its relays from the route it is given (PROTOCOL.md, Remote reach). attestation_roots.json and android_signers.json, new since v0.12.1, are the daemon's and not read by the app either.
